en: Job 7

u.src: 2  As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,

p.src: 3  so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.

en: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.

p.src: 5  My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.

ja: はふさがっては、またただれる。
en: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.
u.src: 5  My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.

p.src: 6  My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

ja: もないままに過ぎ去っていく。
en: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
u.src: 6  My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

p.src: 7  Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.

ja: どうか覚えていてください。
en: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
u.src: 7  Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.

p.src: 8  The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.

ja: る目も、やがて私を見なくなる。 あなたの
en: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.
u.src: 8  The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.

p.src: 9  As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.

ja: え去ってなくなるように、 よみ へ
en: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.

ja: 7:9 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 7:9 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 10  He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.

ja: ることはなく、 彼の場
en: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.
u.src: 10  He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.

p.src: 11  “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

p.src: 12  Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

en: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?
u.src: 12  Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

p.src: 13  When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’

en: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’

en: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,

々は一息にすぎないからだ。
en: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
u.src: 16  I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.

p.src: 17  What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,

en: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?
u.src: 18  that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?

p.src: 19  How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

en: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?
